nodes.description: StorageLayoutV1.owner, the timelock/governance owner address used for authentication

StorageLayoutV1.pauseGuardian, address of the pause guardian

StorageLayoutV1.reentrancyStatus, reentrancy guard storage slot
StorageLayoutV1.nTokenWhitelist, blanket cross-nToken transfer allowance mapping
StorageLayoutV1.nTokenAllowance, per-currency ERC20 style allowance mapping
Router immutable GOVERNANCE implementation address
Router private immutable DEPLOYER used to gate initialize()
StorageLayoutV1.maxCurrencyId, current maximum listed currency id

Router._delegate(address) assembly delegatecall forwarding msg.data
Router fallback() payable, routes msg.sig to _delegate

nTokenRedeem nonReentrant redeem of nTokens into asset cash/fCash

_redeem internal logic reducing token assets and optionally selling fCash
ActionGuards.nonReentrant modifier toggling reentrancyStatus

requireValidAccount rejects reserve, self and nToken addresses

TokenHandler.mint mints cTokens/cETH via external calls
TokenHandler.redeem redeems cTokens/cETH via external calls
Incentives.claimIncentives updates supply and transfers NOTE rewards
checkFreeCollateralAndRevert reverts when account FC is negative
BalanceHandler.finalize updates cash/nToken balances and performs transfers
changeNTokenSupply updates stored total supply and integral supply
External caller address, untrusted input
Block timestamp used for maturity, settlement and incentive math

delegatecall to GOVERNANCE for listCurrency inside initialize
Low level external token transfer/transferFrom via IEIP20NonStandard
External Compound cToken mint/redeem call

spender parameter in nTokenTransferApprove/TransferFrom

initialize assigns pauseGuardian

fallback forwards the call to _delegate

nTokenTransferFrom delegates to internal _transfer

nTokenRedeem calls internal _redeem

normalization_plan.reason: tokensToRedeem_ is a parameter consumed only by nTokenRedeem, merge into that core function node
amount parameter is only used by nTokenTransfer, merge into the function node
currencyId parameter is bound to the nTokenTransferApprove allowance write
spender parameter is stored directly in nTokenAllowance by nTokenTransferApprove
tokensToMint local is produced by calculateTokensToMint and consumed by nTokenMint
tokensToRedeem local is derived inside nTokenRedeem and used for balance reduction
balanceState local mediates all balance writes inside nTokenAction._transfer
implementation local is the delegatecall target inside Router._delegate
